items.title: Dick Hyman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: That’s one. Yeah. And then there’s another one that I whistled on for Johnny Mathis.

ctx.x: Can you tell me a couple of spots that I might hear?
Yeah. Johnny Mathis, there’s one — there’s a famous Mathis record that begins with a piano figure. “Chances Are.”
